name: Japan Sales Reports for WooCommerce
author: datarou

sections.description:
Japan Sales Reports for WooCommerce provides a Japanese-localized sales dashboard for WooCommerce store owners.

Free Features
* Daily, weekly, and monthly sales summary cards
* Daily sales chart (last 30 days) powered by Chart.js
* Top 5 products ranking by revenue

Pro Features ($149/year)
* Consumption tax breakdown report (10% standard rate / 8% reduced rate)
* Monthly report PDF export (ready to hand to your accountant)
* Full product sales ranking (all products)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Japan Reports to view your sales dashboard.

short_description: Sales reports plugin for Japanese WooCommerce store owners. Consumption tax breakdown, monthly PDF export, and daily sales chart.
